newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian GDP seen growing in Q2 -Confindustria.
newsitem.headline: Italian GDP seen growing in Q2 -Confindustria.

text.p: The Italian economy is expected to grow in the second quarter of 1997 after a sharp fall in the first three months of the year, employers' federation Confindustria said in a survey.
"It is very probable that between April and June there will be a solid growth in GDP, even more than one percent by comparison with the first quarter," the survey said.
Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) fell by 0.3 percent quarter-on-quarter, between January and March, and 0.5 percent year-on-year.

But Confindustria noted that average daily output rose, albeit slightly, in April and May, and added that the second quarter data would be boosted by the fact there were two more working days in the period by comparison with the first quarter.
However the employers group said the economic outlook continued to be overshadowed by "fragility" on the demand side.
And it warned that inflation might push up again during the summer when recent growth in labour costs and higher prices for raw materials began to take their toll. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
